# AvatarAgency

> AvatarAgency (avataragency.ai) is a Los Angeles AI consulting and creative agency founded by
> Michael Rivera. It builds digital twins (interactive talking avatars of real people),
> produces cinematic AI video, runs done-for-you content engines for high-ticket businesses,
> optimizes businesses to be recommended by AI assistants (AI Referral Optimization), and
> delivers private 1-on-1 Claude coaching. Sessions are delivered remotely, US-wide.

## Offers

- [AI Referral Optimization](https://avataragency.ai/aiso/): a measured program that makes a
  business visible to ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Perplexity, and Claude when customers ask those
  assistants for a recommendation. Includes a baseline audit of real customer questions across
  all five platforms, a prioritized action plan, implementation across the website and business
  listings (machine-readable structured data, FAQ content, listing consistency), and a re-test
  of the identical questions at 60–90 days to measure the change. Starts with a free AI Referral
  Audit (five questions, five platforms, plain-English report).
- [Claude Coaching](https://avataragency.ai/claudecoaching/): "Master Claude in 90 Minutes" —
  private 1-on-1 AI coaching for busy business owners, professionals, executives, and
  individuals. $497 flat: 30-minute intake call + 60-minute coaching intensive that connects
  Claude (Anthropic's AI assistant) to the client's real email, calendar, and files; builds a
  business "second brain"; automates their biggest time-sink live; includes a written
  quick-reference playbook and 30 days of daily access to Michael's digital-twin AI coach.
  Starts with a free 15-minute discovery call. Premium tier ($1,997) adds done-for-you setup
  of one workflow and a 30-day follow-up call. Independently operated; not affiliated with
  Anthropic.
- [Creative Strategist](https://avataragency.ai/strategist/): AvatarAgency as your outsourced
  creative strategist — digital twin creation, cinematic AI video production, and a complete
  content engine, run for you while you run your business. Engagement begins with a booked
  strategy meeting.
- [Real Estate](https://avataragency.ai/real-estate): interactive AI avatars and video
  for real-estate agents — a digital twin that answers property questions and captures leads
  around the clock.
- [Business](https://avataragency.ai/business): AI video and digital cloning for
  businesses — one cloning session becomes weeks of professional video content. Includes
  UGC-style ad production for brands.
- [Authors](https://avataragency.ai/authors): talking author avatars, illustrated character
  avatars that let readers converse with a book's author or characters, book trailers, and
  author websites.
- [THRIVE](https://avataragency.ai/thrive/): keynote speaking duo — Stephanie Geter (THRIVE
  DOCTOR) and Michael Rivera (Special Agent Rivera) on human connection + AI.

## Pricing (current rate card)

All figures USD. Every engagement is confirmed in a written agreement; multi-deliverable
projects are quoted as a package. Typical rates:

- Free AI Referral Audit: $0 — five real customer questions across ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok,
  Perplexity, and Claude, with a preliminary AI Referral Score.
- AI Referral Optimization program: $1,900–$2,400 depending on the size and complexity of the
  website (baseline audit, action plan, implementation, 60–90 day re-test). Turnaround on the
  free audit that precedes it is 24–48 hours.
- AI-optimized landing page with a 10-email branded drip sequence: $2,400.
- Claude Coaching: $497 (90-minute private session); Premium $1,997 with done-for-you
  workflow setup and 30-day follow-up.
- AI cloning capture session (likeness photography + voice recording, on-site): $250.
- Cinematic AI commercial video (90 seconds): from $750. Professionally edited speaker or
  brand commercial (30 seconds–2 minutes): from $2,500. Multi-film cinematic packages with
  on-site capture: from $5,850.
- Vertical short-form videos (social reels): $250 per video.
- UGC-style ad production for brands: Pilot $1,750 one-time (5 videos, 2 audience segments,
  English + French); Growth retainer $3,200/month (10 videos/month); Always-On retainer
  $5,600/month (20 videos/month). Add-ons: extra hook/CTA variant $75, additional language
  $150 per video, 48-hour rush +30%, whitelisting/Spark Ads rights +25% of package per month.
- Interactive digital twin / character avatar development: from $1,200. Interactive speaker
  page with digital twin and speaker commercial: $4,000. Avatar hosting, knowledge-base
  refreshes, and lead alerts: $79/month (includes 300 conversation minutes/month).
- Website design and build: author/brand sites from $2,150; brand and design system with
  animated homepage experience from $3,000; full site redesign packages (design system, two
  cinematic films, on-site capture, full content migration, SEO + AI-referral structuring)
  from $17,250. Ongoing hosting and maintenance from $149/month.
- Book illustration system (style guide, characters, cover, interior pages): from $3,500.

## Key facts

- Founder: Michael Rivera — Los Angeles; ex-Activision; 15+ years real-estate development;
  AI founder. His own interactive digital twin greets visitors on the homepage.
- Specialty: digital twins that talk in real time (web, with screen-share), cinematic AI
  video without crews or studios, AI Referral Optimization (being recommended by ChatGPT,
  Gemini, Grok, Perplexity, and Claude), and practical AI adoption for owner-operated
  businesses (dentists, orthodontists, lawyers, med spas, real-estate professionals).
- Method note: AvatarAgency audits AI visibility by asking real customer questions in the
  consumer AI products themselves and recording which businesses each assistant recommends
  and which sources it cites. No one can guarantee a particular AI answer; the program
  delivers the audit, the plan, the implementation, and the measurement.
- Contact: https://avataragency.ai/contact — michael@avataragency.ai — +1 (310) 980-9378.
  Hours: Mon–Fri 9:00 AM–6:00 PM, Sat 10:00 AM–3:00 PM Pacific. Based in Los Angeles,
  serving clients across the US and globally (remote delivery).
